info.title: API.SH: OKX
info.description: The OKX API from API.SH: public OKX data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
An OKX instrument's candles with its full history (open, high, low, close, volume in contracts, currency and quote, confirmed flag), oldest first, up to 100 a call. To page back, pass `next_end` as `end`; null when there is no earlier page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/okx-candles

parameters.name: bar
parameters.description: Candle size (default 1D; the utc variants close at UTC midnight).

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Only candles before this time (ISO date, unix time or next_end).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Past futures deliveries and option exercises on OKX for an instrument family: the time, each contract settled and its delivery or exercise price. Page back by passing `next_end` as `end`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/okx-delivery-exercise-history

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Futures deliveries or option exercises (default FUTURES).

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Only records before this time (ISO date, unix time or next_end).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A perpetual swap's current and next funding rate and time, the rate limits, interest rate, premium and settlement state, plus the funding-rate history (rate and realized rate per period). Page the history back by passing `next_end` as `end`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/okx-funding

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: History before this time (ISO date, unix time or next_end).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
OKX index prices (the composite spot price used for marking contracts) with 24 h open, high, low and change, for every index quoted in USD, USDT, USDC or BTC, or for one index.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/okx-index-tickers

parameters.name: quote
parameters.description: Quote currency of the indexes (default USDT).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort the list by this field.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every OKX instrument of one type with state, base, quote and settlement currency, tick and lot size, minimum size, maximum leverage, contract value and multiplier, option type and strike, listing and expiry time and order size limits.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/okx-instruments

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: SPOT (default), MARGIN, SWAP, FUTURES or OPTION.

parameters.name: family
parameters.description: Instrument family such as BTC-USD (required for options).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only instrument ids containing this text.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The OKX insurance fund balance for an instrument family (or a margin coin): the total in USD and the balance changes over time (regular updates, liquidation deposits, bankruptcy losses, platform revenue, auto-deleveraging). Page back by passing `next_end` as `end`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/okx-insurance-fund

parameters.name: family
parameters.description: Instrument family, e.g. BTC-USDT (required except for MARGIN).

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Only records before this time (ISO date, unix time or next_end).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Recent liquidation orders on OKX for an instrument family: side, position side, size, bankruptcy price and loss, time. Filled or unfilled; filter by side. Margin liquidations (`type=MARGIN`) by currency or pair, isolated or cross. `total_loss` gives the site's total loss per instrument. Page back by passing `next_end` as `end`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/okx-liquidations

parameters.name: margin_mode
parameters.description: Margin mode for type=MARGIN: isolated or cross.

parameters.name: inst
parameters.description: Margin pair for type=MARGIN, e.g. BTC-USDT (instead of ccy).

parameters.name: family
parameters.description: Instrument family, e.g. BTC-USDT or BTC-USD (required except for MARGIN).

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Only orders before this time (ISO date, unix time or next_end).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The ratio of accounts long to short on OKX over time, for a coin across its contracts (`ccy`) or for one swap or futures contract (`inst`). For a contract, `scope` also gives the top traders' account ratio or position ratio. Page back by passing `next_end` as `end`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/okx-long-short-ratio

parameters.name: ccy
parameters.description: Coin, e.g. BTC (all its contracts). Use this or inst.

parameters.name: inst
parameters.description: One swap or futures contract, e.g. BTC-USDT-SWAP.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: accounts (default), or the top traders' account / position ratio (inst only).

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Period of each point (default 1H; ccy accepts 5m, 1H, 1D).

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Only points before this time (ISO date, unix time or next_end).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Mark prices of every OKX swap, futures, option or margin pair (the price used for margin and liquidation), or of one instrument or instrument family.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/okx-mark-price

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Instrument type (default SWAP). Ignored when inst is given.

parameters.name: family
parameters.description: Instrument family, e.g. BTC-USDT (required for options, e.g. BTC-USD).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Open interest of OKX swaps, futures or options, in contracts, in coin and in USD, ranked; or of one instrument. For one swap or futures contract, `include` adds `long_short_ratio` (the ratio of accounts long to short) and `taker_volume` (taker sell and buy volume) as time series of `points` periods of `period`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/okx-open-interest

parameters.name: inst
parameters.description: One instrument id instead of the whole list.

parameters.name: family
parameters.description: Instrument family such as BTC-USD (required for options).

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated, with inst (a swap or futures contract): long_short, taker_volume.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every OKX option of a family with its greeks (delta, gamma, vega, theta, in coin and Black-Scholes terms), mark, bid and ask implied volatility, forward price, leverage and APRs, sorted by expiry and strike. Filter by expiry and call/put; `expiries` lists the expiries available.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/okx-option-summary

parameters.name: family
parameters.description: Option family, e.g. BTC-USD or ETH-USD.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
An OKX instrument's order book: bids and asks with price, size and order count per level, best bid and ask and the spread.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/okx-orderbook

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: OKX server time, status and announcements
get.description:
OKX server time, scheduled and ongoing system maintenance (title, state, start and end, affected service), and the latest OKX announcements (title, type, link, publish time), pageable with `page`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/okx-system-time-status

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Only maintenance in this state (default: scheduled and ongoing).

parameters.name: ann_type
parameters.description: Only announcements of this type, e.g. announcements-new-listings, announcements-delistings, announcements-api.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Taker buy and sell volume over time on OKX, with the buy/sell ratio: for a coin on the spot or contracts market (`ccy`), or for one swap or futures contract (`inst`, in coin, contracts or USD). Page back by passing `next_end` as `end`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/okx-taker-volume

parameters.name: ccy
parameters.description: Coin, e.g. BTC. Use this or inst.

parameters.name: inst
parameters.description: One swap or futures contract, e.g. BTC-USDT-SWAP.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Period of each point (default 1H; ccy accepts 5m, 1H, 1D).

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Only points before this time (ISO date, unix time or next_end).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
An OKX instrument's last price and size, best bid and ask, 24-hour open, high, low, change and volume (in contracts and in currency), and the UTC+0 and UTC+8 day opens. Works for spot pairs, perpetual swaps, futures and options. `include` adds `mark_price` (mark price and time), `index_price` (the underlying index with its 24-hour open, high and low) and `price_limit` (the highest buy and lowest sell price currently allowed).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/okx-ticker

parameters.name: inst
parameters.description: OKX instrument id: BTC-USDT (spot), BTC-USDT-SWAP (perpetual), BTC-USD-261225 (future) or an option id.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Tickers of every OKX instrument of one type, ranked by 24-hour volume, change (gainers and losers) or price. For options, `include=greeks` adds each option's `greeks`: delta, gamma, vega and theta (in coin and Black-Scholes terms), mark, bid and ask implied volatility, forward price and leverage.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/okx-tickers

parameters.name: quote
parameters.description: Only instruments quoted in this currency (default USDT for spot), or ALL.

parameters.name: family
parameters.description: Instrument family such as BTC-USD (required for options).

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: greeks: add option greeks and implied volatility (type=OPTION only).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
An OKX instrument's latest trades, newest first: trade id, time, taker side, price and size. `history=true` reads older trades (about the last three months) 100 at a time: pass `next_end` back as `end` for the page before.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/okx-trades

parameters.name: history
parameters.description: true: page back through older trades (with `end`).

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Trade id to page back from: `next_end` of the previous response (implies history).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
